entities.summary: Rogers Garland Albritton was an American philosopher who served as chair of the Harvard and UCLA philosophy departments. He published little and inspired the entry "albritton" in the Philosophical Lexicon begun by Daniel Dennett. Albritton's specialties included ancient philosophy, philosophy of mind, free will, skepticism, metaphysics and the work of Ludwig Wittgenstein.
